title: Identifying and Overcoming the Devil's Fire Darts in Your Mind
description: In this powerful message, Pastor Chris Zehner exposes the enemy's tactics to infiltrate our minds with lies and deception. Learn how to identify the "fiery darts" of the devil and how to shield yourself with the truth of God's Word, taking back control of your thoughts and emotions. Don't miss this crucial teaching on spiritual warfare and how to finish strong in your faith.
